---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new capability or enhancement for TerraFlow
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement, feature-request, needs-triage
assignees: ''
---

## Problem Statement

What problem does this solve? Who runs into it, and how often?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the smallest useful version of the feature. As a traveler or explorer, I want to ... so that ...

## Alternatives Considered

What simpler, safer, or already-available alternatives did you consider, and why don't they fully solve the problem?

## Product Fit

Explain how this keeps the globe central and preserves exploration before login (see [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md) / README product principles).

## Priority

- [ ] Low
- [ ] Medium
- [ ] High

## Additional Context

Mockups, related issues, links, or prior discussion.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The feature is discoverable from the globe experience.
- [ ] Login is required only when necessary.
- [ ] Empty, loading, and error states are handled.
- [ ] Documentation or tests are updated when relevant.
